metric_definitions.name: BRAD Baseline Unit Test Pass Rate
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of official baseline unit and contract tests passing in Node and Python harnesses.

metric_definitions.name: BRAD Candidate Test Pass Rate
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of candidate branch tests passing including new regression tests.

metric_definitions.name: RelayDesk Server Automated Test Pass Rate
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of end-to-end SDLC API and integration tests passing against local SQLite.

metric_definitions.name: Canonical Routing Cases Evaluated
metric_definitions.description: Total count of canonical routing specifications evaluated from evals/routing-cases.json.

metric_definitions.name: Level 1 Contract Definition Rate
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of canonical cases with unambiguous static contract definitions in BRAD documentation.

metric_definitions.name: Level 3 Exact Native Skill Route Rate
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of canonical cases matching exact native skill identifiers.

metric_definitions.name: Level 4 Native Workflow Execution Rate
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of native BMAD workflows actually executed by host.

metric_definitions.name: Cross-Team Collaboration Exercises Completed
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of mandatory multi-worktree collaboration exercises successfully executed with git commits.

metric_definitions.name: QA Defect Retest & Closure Rate
metric_definitions.description: Proportion of logged QA defects reproduced, fixed, retested, and verified closed.
